主要内容: On February 11, 2021, Insperity, Inc. issued a press release announcing the company’s financial and operating results for the quarter and year ended December 31, 2020. The press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated by reference. The company is registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission under Commission File Number 1-13998 and has its principal executive offices at 19001 Crescent Springs Drive, Kingwood, Texas 77339. The press release includes details about the company’s financial performance and operating results for the specified periods. The company is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol NSP. The press release is part of the Form 8-K filing, which is required under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing includes financial statements and exhibits related to the company’s results. The press release is signed by Daniel D. Herink, Senior Vice President of Legal, General Counsel and Secretary, on behalf of Insperity, Inc. on February 11, 2021.
